title: Which channel receives invoice.paid in the staging eventbus demo
prompt:
We're validating the staging routing overrides in `eventbus/config.py` (this repository) before tomorrow's release. When

    python3 -m eventbus.demo --env staging

publishes its single `invoice.paid` event, which channel, other than `audit`, records a delivery?

Answer with the channel name only.
verify: python3 -m eventbus.demo --env staging | grep -v '^audit:' | head -n 1 | cut -d: -f1
